review.text: I cannot speak highly enough of Sean and his team at French Roofing. Consummate professionals from start to finish with decades of experience in this industry. I wouldn't trust an investment of this magnitude or my home to anyone else. Top quality delivered by honest, hardworking and fun people.
review.notes: 'decades of experience' kept only on the full-review card (BRAND.md proof point is 10+ years).
